history.overview: The Halls were built as the ceremonial and logistical artery of the Outer Citadel.

timeline.name: Hall Excavation
timeline.description: Dragorn slaves carved the initial hall structure.

timeline.name: Pillar Reinforcement
timeline.description: Discord‑infused pillars were installed to support the vaulted ceilings.

timeline.name: Ward Installation
timeline.description: Inquisitors embedded Discord wards into the hall walls.

timeline.name: Ceremonial Marches
timeline.description: Muramite officers began using the halls for ceremonial troop movements.
